description.value: Your playful performances inspire others to join in with you, and these performances often spark larger faun revelries and spiral into high-energy parties. Once per day, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Enthrall], @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Hypnotize], or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Levitate] as an occult innate spell. You choose which spell you cast each time you use this ability.
